scope: Concept previews only; no modeling, game installation, or skill changes.

images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one premium fantasy MMORPG staff weapon concept for a coherent NOBLE BLUE MOON set, to compare silhouettes before any modeling. Full-length single staff, upright, complete tip to bottom, strict orthographic front elevation with just enough softly shaded volume to reveal polished facets. Portrait composition, weapon occupies 90 percent of height, generous clean margin around the head. Uniform near-black navy background. Noble, elegant, sophisticated blue moon identity. The physical material itself is rich luminous azure, sapphire blue and blue opalescent moonstone; NOT gray steel painted blue. Very thin pale silver filigree accents only, no gold. Crisp readable blue shapes at gameplay thumbnail scale, intentional large negative spaces. Extremely polished high-end hand-painted/3D game item concept, refined hierarchy instead of noisy tiny decoration. No characters, hands, scene, ground, labels, text, watermark, border, secondary weapon or alternate views. No external bloom cloud or giant halo hiding the actual edges. The crescent moon must be physically part of the head silhouette, not merely a logo pasted on. Do not crop any part.
Variant T1, FULL MOON SANCTUARY: A grand broad round head, one luminous pearly blue full-moon sphere visibly cradled from below by a single enormous upward-opening azure crescent like a sacred chalice. The two tapered crescent tips rise around the sides of the sphere without closing at the top. Architectural, serene and regal, dominant smooth circular silhouette. A slender long shaft continues into the deep keel of the crescent cradle, with restrained teardrop blue gemstone nodes and elegant blue fluting. Clear bright moon sphere dominates, not a spiky trident or flower.
images.review: Full staff visible; no text; distinct lunar head silhouette; blue gemstone body with pale-silver accents.
images.visual_review: Large round full moon physically cradled by a wide upward crescent; distinct circular sanctuary silhouette.
